text: Seeds 74 and 75 (same d128/5000-step config, separate experiments) both give a final force margin of about 0.21 with a late gain of 0.09 or more, but force peaks at layer 4 in seed 74 and at layer 1 (the distance layer) in seed 75. Is the late force gain carried by the same layer across seeds? If it is not, is the per-layer force profile flat within about 0.03 at step 5000?
